answer: code-based identity proof is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 529 pays 8993 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The comet test is the live device, the spiral test is the locked stake, and the orchard test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
